_doc: The Klein picture pod of the LTX A/B (W5, plan RUNPOD_AB_PLAN.md section 5, the creator's word cmsg_01Hnu5zB86sjUj5GtTgaUkPWU9kS1kT1CnB6HveYkz5rfQ): open-weights FLUX Klein on a small RunPod pod instead of the BFL API (level 3 of picture_route.json). Every value marked null is an OPEN pin (OR-22): the runner and `plan` refuse until it is recorded; nothing here is guessed.

flux-3-image-klein.layout: diffusers modular pipeline (modular_model_index.json; transformer, text_encoder, vae); the prompt_upsampler block is popped, as the model card shows (the plan thread writes the full captions)
flux-3-image-klein.files_why: read 2026-11-19 ~18:25 UTC from the repo at the pinned revision with the project token (resolve headers): a 64-hex value is the LFS sha256 (X-Linked-ETag), a 40-hex value is the git blob sha1 of a small file (ETag); ~20.3 GB in all: modular_model_index.json, transformer/, text_encoder/ and vae/ only (no ae.safetensors copy, no variants, no prompt upsampler). The pod hashes them again in L2; they were not hashed locally from the bytes.

pipeline_why: the model card says `pip install git+https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers.git`; the released diffusers 0.43.0 (PyPI, 2026-11-12) was opened here and contains Flux3DistilledAutoBlocks, Flux3Transformer2DModel, AutoencoderKLFlux2, ModularPipeline and the flux3 prompt_upsampler block, so it is pinned instead of a git main commit (a reviewed choice: the model's own index says 0.41.0.dev0; L3 on the card proves it loads). The runner loads from a scratch copy of the verified files whose index points at the local folder (no hub id, prompt upsampler entries removed) with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
image_why: the pinned tmr_pod digest of config/cloud_pins.json (the Modal LTX base_image too). Evidence read by the plan thread from its ghcr config 2026-11-19 ~18:18 UTC (not read here): CUDA_VERSION 12.8.1, cuDNN 9.8, NVIDIA_REQUIRE_CUDA cuda>=12.8, Ubuntu 24.04, python 3.12. cloud_pins keeps smoke_verified false: the L3 smoke on the card decides; if it fails on Blackwell the pod stops after setup and that cost is inside the cap; the same image as the LTX pod (one CUDA 12.8 proof for both)

cards.note: the plan thread's card (peak 31 GB BF16, upsampler off, so 32 GB is too tight), 2026-11-19 ~18:13 UTC; price not read here
not enough margin for 31 GB peak; listed only as history

container_disk_why: ~21 GB of diffusers weights (an estimate from the plan, not measured) plus pictures; no network volume
cap_why: the creator's card answer, 2026-11-19 18:10 UTC (decision cmsg_01Hnu5zB86sjUj5GtTgaUkPWSwoXZ54YzeRW8d48Sfsewv), confirmed to this thread by his own message cmsg_01Hnu5zB86sjUj5GtTgaUkPWSuqhe7svtHM5ptNMiw84V4 (18:13 UTC): $0.60 for the picture pod with FLUX 3 Klein; guard stop at it, PROBLEM at 80 % ($0.48). `create --max-usd` must be this same number. A ceiling, not a target.

minutes.source: RUNPOD_AB_PLAN.md section 5 minutes (made for $0.72/h; at the L40S $1.09/h expected is about $0.36, max about $0.64: a REVIEW line, the guard stops at the cap); estimates, not measured on this card

model_why: plan thread, 2026-11-19 18:11 UTC: the owner chose FLUX 3 Klein; `models` can hold another id, `model` picks it
transformers_why: pinned after an import proof, not a load proof: in a clean CPU venv with diffusers 0.43.0, huggingface_hub 1.33.0 and transformers 5.22.2 (PyPI 2026-11-06), ModularPipeline, Flux3Transformer2DModel, AutoencoderKLFlux2, Flux3DistilledAutoBlocks, Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration and Qwen3VLProcessor import; and with the real modular_model_index.json of the pinned revision rewritten by `local_modular_index`, `ModularPipeline.from_pretrained(local).blocks`, `pop('prompt_upsampler')` and `init_pipeline(local)` build a Flux3DistilledModularPipeline with components text_encoder, tokenizer, image_processor, vae, transformer, scheduler, offline. The weights load is proved only by L3 on the card
